output.title: DNS caching improves performance across all DNS challenge operations
output.content: This change improves cert-manager's DNS zone lookup performance by caching DNS responses and handling TTL expiration. This optimization applies to any cert-manager deployment using DNS challenges (DNS01, ACME). The environment configuration shows global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole is set, indicating active certificate challenges. This performance improvement plausibly benefits all DNS-based challenge operations in this environment.
